    def _text_index(self, itemnum):
        metadata = self.meta_data if isinstance(self.meta_data, dict) else {}
        fields, vectorizers, matrices = {}, {}, []
        cleaned = {}
        for field in ("title", "description"):
            texts = []
            for item in range(1, itemnum + 1):
                info = metadata.get(str(item), metadata.get(item, {}))
                texts.append(
                    self._clean_text(info.get(field, ""))
                    if isinstance(info, dict)
                    else ""
                )
            cleaned[field] = texts
            vectorizer = TfidfVectorizer(
                analyzer="word",
                ngram_range=(1, 2),
                token_pattern=r"(?u)\b\w\w+\b",
                stop_words=None,
                min_df=1,
                max_df=1.0,
                max_features=100000,
                binary=False,
                sublinear_tf=True,
                use_idf=True,
                smooth_idf=True,
                norm="l2",
                dtype=np.float64,
            )
            try:
                matrix = vectorizer.fit_transform(texts)
            except ValueError as error:
                if "empty vocabulary" not in str(error):
                    raise
                matrix = sparse.csr_matrix((itemnum, 0), dtype=np.float64)
                vectorizer = None
            fields[field] = {
                "nonempty_text_items": sum(bool(t) for t in texts),
                "nonzero_vector_items": int(np.count_nonzero(matrix.getnnz(axis=1))),
                "vocabulary_size": matrix.shape[1],
                "empty_vocabulary": vectorizer is None,
            }
            matrices.append(matrix)
            vectorizers[field] = vectorizer
        combined = sparse.hstack(matrices, format="csr")
        if combined.shape[1]:
            combined = normalize(combined, norm="l2", copy=False)
        fields["item_zero_vector_rate"] = float(np.mean(combined.getnnz(axis=1) == 0))
        return combined, vectorizers, fields, self._digest(cleaned)

    def _mean_user_summary(records, conditions):

        users = {}
        for record in records:
            users.setdefault(record["user_id"], []).append(record["values"])

            "rank",
            "hit10",
            "reciprocal_rank",
            "max_competitor_margin",
            "known_later_positive_fraction",
            "fallback_fraction",
        )
        arrays = []
        for user in sorted(users):
            arrays.append(np.asarray(users[user], dtype=np.float64).mean(axis=0))
        values = (
            np.stack(arrays) if arrays else np.empty((0, len(conditions), len(names)))
        )
        means = values.mean(axis=0) if len(values) else None
        summary = {
            "users": len(users),
            "prefixes": len(records),
            "conditions": {
                condition: {
                    name: None if means is None else float(means[c, j])
                    for j, name in enumerate(names)
